results.title: 로그아웃 요청이 서버에 도착하지 않은 경우
results.level: real PostgREST + Realtime (TTL 6 s lab setting)
results.note: Residual exposure is bounded by the lease TTL, not by logout. A GoTrue sign-out does not close an already-joined Realtime channel (the JWT stays valid until exp); the app MUST call leave on logout and the lease TTL bounds the failure case.
results.expected: deliveries stop no later than lease expiry (+ one send interval)

results.title: Realtime 연결 상태에서 제재 발생
results.note: The control row shows Realtime keeps delivering to an already-joined channel after the sanction: the server-side refusal to publish is the ONLY delivery boundary.
results.expected: server refuses to publish to the sanctioned recipient; nothing delivered; re-join refused

results.title: RPC 승인 응답의 capability 정보 누출 여부
results.note: senderClientSessionId (the sender's own declared presence id) is present by design for Stage B avatar binding; it is not a recipient capability.
